meta.description: Boston Milal Korean Church — warm Presbyterian congregation in Chelmsford, MA. Sunday worship 10:00 AM.

home.title: Home
home.motto: Serve one another as good stewards (1 Peter 4:10)
home.intro: We are a Korean Presbyterian congregation in Chelmsford, gathering each Sunday to worship, grow, and serve one another with sincerity.
home.verifyNote: Motto and schedule details marked for church confirmation.

worship.title: Worship & gatherings
worship.intro: Weekly worship and prayer gatherings. Rows marked for confirmation with the church before treating as final.
worship.onlineBody: Join livestreams and past services on our YouTube channel.

visit.title: Visit / New family
visit.intro: We are glad you are considering a visit. Here is what to expect.
visit.expectBody: Come as you are. Sunday worship begins at 10:00 AM in the main sanctuary. You will find welcome, scripture, prayer, and fellowship. Stay after for greetings if you like — no pressure.
visit.parkingBody: Park in the lot at 15 Alpha Road, Chelmsford, MA 01824. Enter through the main entrance. (Arrival details VERIFY-WITH-CHURCH.)
visit.kidsBody: Children's worship meets during Sunday service. See Generations for age-band times and rooms.
visit.contactBody: Questions? Please ask after worship, or reach us via the Facebook page linked in the footer. Email and phone will appear here once confirmed — we do not list unverified contacts.

about.title: About the church
about.intro: Boston Milal Korean Church is a sincere Presbyterian congregation in Chelmsford, Massachusetts. Our name, Milal (wheat), points to humble growth and hospitality.
about.motto: Serve one another as good stewards (1 Peter 4:10)
about.pastorBio: Chongshin University (Theology); M.Div. / Th.M. Gordon-Conwell; formerly senior pastor of Lebanon Korean Presbyterian Church.
about.pastorVerify: Pastoral details VERIFY-WITH-CHURCH before treating as final.
about.identity: We gather as a Korean-speaking Presbyterian church family in Greater Boston, seeking to worship faithfully and serve one another.

sermons.title: Sermons
sermons.intro: Watch services on YouTube and read published sermon summaries.

koreanSchool.title: Korean School
koreanSchool.intro: Sunday Korean language and culture classes for the next generation.
koreanSchool.goals: Help children grow in Korean language, cultural identity, and community — learning with joy alongside the church family.
koreanSchool.time: Sundays 9:30–10:30 AM (spring and fall semesters). VERIFY-WITH-CHURCH.
koreanSchool.contact: Classes meet at 15 Alpha Road, Chelmsford, MA 01824. For questions, please ask after worship. Phone and email omitted until confirmed.
koreanSchool.noAlbums: Teacher rosters and photo albums are not published on this site.
